definitions.explanation: Focusing on one thing only, to the exclusion of others.
Something that is widely said or believed.

examples.english: Recently, I've been working exclusively from home.

examples.japanese: ⟦{休日|きゅうじつ}→きゅうじつ：03028_kyuujitsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{専|もっぱ}ら⟦{読書|どくしょ}→どくしょ：03484_dokusho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→じかん：00468_jikan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{費|つい}やしている→ついやす：10424_tsuiyasu⟧。
examples.english: On my days off I spend my time mainly on reading.

⟦{来月|らいげつ}→らいげつ：00744_raigetsu⟧⟦{辞|や}める→やめる：00909_yameru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦いう→いう：00515_iu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{専|もっぱ}ら⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{噂|うわさ}→うわさ：01871_uwasa⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: The word going around is that he's quitting next month.

examples.japanese: ⟦{社長|しゃちょう}→しゃちょう：01428_shachou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{交代|こうたい}→こうたい：04146_koutai⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦いう→いう：00515_iu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{専|もっぱ}ら⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{噂|うわさ}→うわさ：01871_uwasa⟧⟦だが→だが：00031_daga⟧、⟦{本当|ほんとう}→ほんとう：00779_hontou⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦どう→どう：00543_dou⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦わからない→わかる：00463_wakaru⟧。
examples.english: The prevailing rumor is that the president is being replaced, but no one knows if it's true.

notes:
{専|もっぱ}ら indicates exclusivity or dedication to one thing, often translated as 'exclusively,' 'solely,' or 'mainly.'

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {専|もっぱ}ら〜⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧: to be doing exclusively ~
- {専|もっぱ}ら〜⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→じかん：00468_jikan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→つかう：00473_tsukau⟧: to spend time mainly on ~

SET EXPRESSION:
{専|もっぱ}ら⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{噂|うわさ}→うわさ：01871_uwasa⟧ means 'what everyone's saying' or 'the word on the street'—a rumor that's widely circulating.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {専|もっぱ}ら: exclusively, mainly (somewhat formal)
- ⟦だけ→だけ：03093_dake⟧: only (neutral)
- ⟦ばかり→ばかり：02006_bakari⟧: nothing but (often with negative nuance)
